description: (Na)₂KAsF₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a KAsF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the KAsF₆ framework, K is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form KF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AsF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All K-F bond lengths are 2.48 Å. As is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form AsF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent KF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All As-F bond lengths are 2.05 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one K and one As atom.
